results.snippet:
She discusses how the Central African Republic (CAR) forestry sector is plagued by state capture and chronic regulatory neglect. The report finds nearly 40% of CAR’s commercial logging area is controlled by Russia’s Wagner Group and Chinese timber firms that routinely violate the country’s forestry laws and fail to deliver valuable returns to local communities.
